text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis and dashboarding, with skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization.

Your Real Estate Lead Qualifier role caught my attention because it combines outreach, persistence, and performance-driven work. While my background is in data, I’m used to working with accuracy, structure, and follow-through—skills that translate well to qualifying leads, keeping records clean, and staying organized in a fast-moving sales process. I’m comfortable working from clear targets, maintaining consistency, and making sure the right information is captured and acted on.

One project I built was an HR attrition dashboard for a confidential manufacturing client. I used Power BI, Excel, and SQL to create an attrition and absence dashboard where each plant manager could only see their own plant through row-level security. That dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped identify attrition hotspots in 2 plants. The project required careful data handling, attention to detail, and building a solution that gave the right people the right information—qualities I’d bring to lead qualification as well.

I’m especially strong in structured workflows, data quality, and reporting. If your team needs someone who can stay organized, work with consistency, and support the sales process with disciplined execution, I’d be glad to help. I also understand the importance of clear communication and keeping momentum in a performance-based role.

I’d welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team and help move qualified leads forward. If helpful, I can also work with your team to keep outreach activity and lead status information clean, consistent, and easy to review.
